learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basic principles of signal compression.
Understand and use the current standards for image, video, and audio compression.
Know the basic error resilience and error concealment techniques for video.
Understand the techniques for video transmission over networks.

syllabus_topics: Error resilience and error concealment for video
Laboratory exercises (using Matlab or Octave) on compression of images, video, and audio
teaching_methods: Use of projector and board during lectures
Posting of teaching material (lecture slides and notes, data and code)
Use of email direct communication with students
assessment_rules: The final examination counts for 70% of the grade, and laboratory exercises count for 30%. The evaluation procedure is accessible to students via the course website.
